structured_steps.title: Isolate the variable term
structured_steps.reason: Inverse operations eliminate the constant term on the left side of the equation.

structured_steps.title: Solve for x by division
structured_steps.content: Divide both sides by the coefficient of x (2): x = 10 / 2 = 5.
structured_steps.reason: Dividing by the coefficient isolates the variable x to yield its exact root.

structured_steps.title: Check and state final answer
structured_steps.content: Substitute x = 5 into LHS: 2(5) + 5 = 10 + 5 = 15 (equals RHS). Therefore, the solution is x = 5.
structured_steps.reason: Substitution confirms that the calculated value satisfies the original equation.

verification_details.details: Verified by substituting proposed root (5) into LHS (2x + 5) and RHS (15). Evaluated result: LHS = 15, RHS = 15 (difference: 0.000000).

concept_analysis.evidence: Question explicitly exercises core problem-solving methods from Real Numbers.
Step-by-step transformation utilizes bidirectional equality rules.

possible_mistakes.evidence: Common student mistake is forgetting to flip signs when moving terms across the equals sign (+ becomes -, - becomes +).
possible_mistakes.suggested_correction: Always explicitly show the operation on both sides of the equation before simplifying.

possible_mistakes.evidence: Dividing the wrong term or inverted fractions when solving for the final variable.
possible_mistakes.suggested_correction: Check that both sides are divided by the exact coefficient including any negative signs.

practice_questions.explanation: Subtract 9 from 24 to get 15, then divide 15 by 3 to get x = 5.
Add 8 to both sides: 4y = 24. Divide by 4: y = 6.
